name: 7 Minutes in the Closet
source:
You're pushed into playing 7 minutes in heaven at a party with a stranger. Everything goes wrong and you are stuck in there with him.

[From [url=https://3005jin.itch.io/7-minutes-in-the-closet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一场派对上，你被众人起哄推进衣橱，和一名陌生男生玩起了“天堂七分钟”游戏。谁知状况百出，你们二人竟双双被困在了衣橱里面。

[摘自[url=https://3005jin.itch.io/7-minutes-in-the-closet]itch.io[/url]]
